subject: Null calibration of the parity and ownership rules added to tools/event_review.py on 25 October 2026
method: Event depths of every M/K BOI re-measured with the same baseline at phase offsets 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.65, 0.75 and 0.85 (no transit, away from phase 0.5); the declared statistics computed on those null trials.
detector_odd_even: The detector flags 45 of 663 M/K BOIs (6.8%) at odd/even >= 3 sigma, close to the 8.1% null rate of the local within-quarter statistic; the flag is kept as a conservative selection requirement and is not evidence of an eclipsing binary.
verdict: Both rules FAILED calibration. Parity and ownership columns stay as descriptive measurements; no disposition, false-positive claim or batch change uses them. Batch 6 keeps the 28 odd/even-flagged signals.
conservative_flags: INSTRUMENTAL_DATE_DRIVEN, SINGLE_EVENT_DRIVEN and NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_LOCAL_SAP compare shares of S/N squared or require low S/N; underestimated errors overstate S/N, so these flags err towards keeping a signal.
